title: Quick Landscape Impression Alongside the Hudson River
content: In this YouTube video (Link to video), I paint a quiet estuary from the edge of a forest.I'm using casein paint, a gouache-like paint that was popular before acrylics. Along the way I share tips for capturing that simple first impression.Here are the colors I'm using.The forest is shadowy, and the light increases as we go out into the fringes of the estuary. This painting is a fairly quick one, about 45 minutes altogether.----Gumroad tutorial: Casein in the Wild
